name: Payment Instruction
definition: Instruction to pay an amount of money to an ultimate beneficiary, on behalf of an originator. This instruction may have to be forwarded several times to complete the settlement chain.

InstructionForNextAgent.name: Instruction For Next Agent
InstructionForNextAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the next agent. |Usage: The next agent may not be the creditor agent.|The instruction can relate to a level of service, can be an instruction that has to be executed by the agent, or can be information required by the next agent.

ClearingChargeAmount.name: Clearing Charge Amount
ClearingChargeAmount.definition: Amount of money taken by a clearing agent as compensation for the processing of the payment instruction. This charge is paid either by the debtor or by the creditor or shared between them.

ProcessingValidityTime.name: Processing Validity Time
ProcessingValidityTime.definition: Date and time range within which the payment instruction must be processed.

SettlementInstruction.name: Settlement Instruction
SettlementInstruction.definition: Instruction for the cash settlement between two clearing agents.

StandingOrder.name: Standing Order
StandingOrder.definition: Instruction given by an account holder to an account servicer to make regular transfers on given dates to the same beneficiary.

Previous.name: Previous
Previous.definition: Specifies that a payment instruction may be preceeded by another payment instruction.
